Chapter 17
Summary of the Science of Getting Rich
There is a thinking substance from which all things are made. In its original state, it permeates, penetrates, and fills the spaces of the universe.
A thought within this substance produces the very thing that the thought imagines.
A person can form things in their mind, and, by impressing those thoughts upon the formless substance, can cause the thing they think about to be created.

To do this, a person must shift from a competitive mindset to a creative one. Otherwise, they cannot be in harmony with the Formless Intelligence, which is always creative and never competitive in spirit.

A person can come into full harmony with the Formless Substance by holding a deep and sincere gratitude for the blessings it gives them. Gratitude connects the human mind with the intelligence of the Substance, so that the person's thoughts are received by the Formless. A person can only remain on the creative level by uniting themselves with the Formless Intelligence through a deep and continuous feeling of gratitude.

A person must form a clear and specific mental picture of the things they want to have, do, or become. They must hold this mental picture in their thoughts while being deeply grateful to the Supreme Power that all their desires are being granted. Anyone who wants to get rich must spend their free time contemplating their Vision, and offering sincere thanks that it is becoming a reality. You cannot place too much emphasis on the importance of frequently contemplating the mental image, combined with unwavering faith and deep gratitude. This is the exact process by which the impression is given to the Formless, and the creative forces are set into motion.

The creative energy works through the established channels of natural growth, as well as through the existing industrial and social order. Everything included in their mental picture will surely be brought to the person who follows these instructions and whose faith does not waver. What they want will come to them through the normal channels of trade and commerce.

In order to receive what is theirs when it arrives, a person must take action. This action must consist of more than just filling their current role. They must keep the Purpose of getting rich in mind through the realization of their mental picture. And they must do everything that can be done each day, taking care to do every single act in a successful manner. They must give every person more in use value than the cash value they receive, so that every transaction adds more to life. And they must hold onto the Advancing Thought so strongly that the impression of Increase is communicated to everyone they meet.

The men and women who practice these instructions will certainly get rich. And the wealth they receive will be in exact proportion to the clarity of their vision, the strength of their purpose, the steadiness of their faith, and the depth of their gratitude.
